preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of integers N on the blackboard must be between 6 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each integer A[i] on the blackboard must be between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the number of operations M, which must be between 0 and 11111.
Each of the M lines must contain exactly 3 integers representing the chosen numbers for the operation.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(x) in A for x in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:M+1])
postconditions.description: Each integer in the operations must be present on the blackboard at the time of the operation.
